title: Parking 1 ECS per 100 sqm built-up area for plots exceeding 300 sqm (plotted residential, clause viii.b)

citations.original_text: b. 1 ECS for every 100sq.m. built up area, in plots exceeding 300 sq.m, provided that, if the permissible coverage and FAR is not achieved with the above mentioned parking norms in a plot, the parking norms of the preceding category shall be allowed.

notes: Plotted-residential parking for plots > 300 sqm (page 154, clause viii.b): 1 ECS per 100 sqm built-up area. The proviso (fall back to the preceding category's norm if coverage/FAR cannot be met) is not modelled. Replaces the earlier draft that wrongly used the group-housing 2.0 ECS/100sqm from page 156.
user_caveat: The proviso allowing a fall back to the preceding category's norm where coverage or FAR cannot otherwise be met is not modelled here.
